name: How Sweet to Be an Idiot

podcast.body: A song from a 1973 sketch. The writer, Neil Innes, won a co-writing credit on Oasis's 1994 song "Whatever" after asserting its similarity to the Python track. "a song from a 1973 sketch called How Sweet to Be an Idiot."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.body: This song, from a 1973 sketch, was the basis for a lawsuit against Oasis. Monty Python "insisted that the 1994 song Whatever sounded way too much like" "How Sweet to Be an Idiot." Neil Innis, the writer of the Python song, "won a co-writing credit on Oasis's Whatever." "They insisted that the 1994 song Whatever sounded way too much like a song from a 1973 sketch called How Sweet to Be an Idiot."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
